about: The skies of pack s17-sky (ART-56, Zafar 6 Nov; art plan docs/design-language/art-plans/s17-sky-art-plan.md section 5), cut by build/tools/art/artcut.py from sources/art/s17-sky/ into assets/backgrounds/s17-sky/ (a new folder: nothing in the game points at it until a build session wires it). Every sky is a full picture, no key: one `background` job each, at the source's own size (WebP q 86, no @2x: the plan says never past the source). The two derived files the cutter cannot make (door-sun.webp, the 4:3 cover crop of SC01 at 960x720, and the -tile copies of the two skies the game lays side by side, the seam cross-faded 64 px with artlib.make_tileable) are made by sources/art/s17-sky/post-cut.py straight after, which adds them to cut-data.json. Names are the plan's: today's files' names for the door skies and the sun card, sky-<time>-wide / -square for the bank.
